objects.name: assessment_answers
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE assessment_answers (
      id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, user_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      item_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES assessment_items(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
      response TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}' CHECK(json_valid(response)),
      confidence INTEGER CHECK(confidence IS NULL OR confidence IN (1,2,3)),
      dont_know INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(dont_know IN (0,1)),
      saved_at TEXT NOT NULL,
      score REAL CHECK(score IS NULL OR score >= 0),
      grade_status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending' CHECK(grade_status IN ('pending','provisional','final')),
      grader TEXT CHECK(grader IS NULL OR grader IN ('auto','ai','ai_accepted','self','manual')),
      criteria TEXT CHECK(criteria IS NULL OR json_valid(criteria)),
      feedback TEXT CHECK(feedback IS NULL OR json_valid(feedback)),
      mistake_category TEXT,
      graded_at TEXT,
      attempt INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(attempt >= 1),
      created_at TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
    )

objects.name: assessment_items
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE assessment_items (
      id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, user_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      assessment_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES assessments(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
      question_id TEXT REFERENCES question_items(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
      position INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(position >= 0),
      topic_id TEXT REFERENCES subject_topics(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
      dimension TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(dimension IN ('recognition','recall','understanding','application')),
      max_score REAL NOT NULL CHECK(max_score > 0),
      question_snapshot TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(question_snapshot)),
      created_at TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
      UNIQUE (assessment_id, position)
    )

objects.name: assessments
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE assessments (
      id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, user_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      subject_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES subjects(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
      journey_id TEXT REFERENCES learning_journeys(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
      kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(kind IN ('diagnostic','practice','final','retention')),
      title TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
      config TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}' CHECK(json_valid(config)),
      status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft' CHECK(status IN ('draft','in_progress','submitted','graded','abandoned')),
      attempt INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(attempt >= 1),
      retake_of TEXT REFERENCES assessments(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
      started_at TEXT, submitted_at TEXT, graded_at TEXT, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
    )

      archived_at TEXT, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
    )

objects.name: finance_categories
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE finance_categories (
      id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, user_id TEXT NOT NULL, name TEXT NOT NULL, kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(kind IN ('income','expense')),
      archived_at TEXT, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, UNIQUE(user_id,name,kind)
    )

objects.name: finance_transactions
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE finance_transactions (
      id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, user_id TEXT NOT NULL, kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(kind IN ('income','expense','transfer')),
      date TEXT NOT NULL, amount_minor INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(amount_minor > 0), description TEXT NOT NULL,
      category_id TEXT REFERENCES finance_categories(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
      account_id TEXT REFERENCES finance_accounts(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
      source_account_id TEXT REFERENCES finance_accounts(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
      destination_account_id TEXT REFERENCES finance_accounts(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
      note TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', created_at TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
      CHECK((kind='transfer' AND account_id IS NULL AND source_account_id IS NOT NULL AND destination_account_id IS NOT NULL AND source_account_id<>destination_account_id AND category_id IS NULL)
        OR (kind IN ('income','expense') AND account_id IS NOT NULL AND source_account_id IS NULL AND destination_account_id IS NULL))
    )

CREATE TABLE focus_entries (

    )

    )

objects.name: learning_journeys
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE learning_journeys (
      id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, user_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      subject_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES subjects(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
      title TEXT NOT NULL,
      stage TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'material' CHECK(stage IN ('material','pretest_setup','pretest','diagnostic','targeted_notes','main_learning','practice','mistake_analysis','supplementary','final_learning','final_exam','report','retention')),
      status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active' CHECK(status IN ('active','completed','archived')),
      cycle INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(cycle >= 1),
      parent_journey_id TEXT REFERENCES learning_journeys(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
      target_date TEXT, completed_at TEXT, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
    )

objects.name: learning_materials
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE learning_materials (
      id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, user_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      subject_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES subjects(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
      journey_id TEXT REFERENCES learning_journeys(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
      topic_id TEXT REFERENCES subject_topics(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
      session_id TEXT REFERENCES learning_sessions(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
      kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(kind IN ('targeted_note','side_note','side_note_ai','supplementary')),
      parent_material_id TEXT REFERENCES learning_materials(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
      title TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
      body_file TEXT,
      source TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]' CHECK(json_valid(source)),
      origin TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'manual',
      provenance TEXT CHECK(provenance IS NULL OR json_valid(provenance)),
      created_at TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
      CHECK(kind <> 'side_note_ai' OR parent_material_id IS NOT NULL)
    )

objects.name: learning_schedule
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE learning_schedule (
      id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, user_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      event_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES events(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
      journey_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES learning_journeys(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
      kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(kind IN ('session','practice','retention','final')),
      topic_ids TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]' CHECK(json_valid(topic_ids)),
      created_at TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
    )

objects.name: learning_sessions
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE learning_sessions (
      id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, user_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      subject_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES subjects(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
      journey_id TEXT REFERENCES learning_journeys(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
      topic_id TEXT REFERENCES subject_topics(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
      kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(kind IN ('main','supplementary','review')),
      started_at TEXT NOT NULL, ended_at TEXT,
      focus_entry_id TEXT REFERENCES focus_entries(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
      summary TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
      visited TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{"sections":[],"materials":[]}' CHECK(json_valid(visited)),
      created_at TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
    )

objects.name: question_items
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE question_items (
      id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, user_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      subject_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES subjects(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
      topic_id TEXT REFERENCES subject_topics(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
      type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(type IN ('choice','truefalse','matching','essay','explain')),
      dimension TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(dimension IN ('recognition','recall','understanding','application')),
      difficulty INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 2 CHECK(difficulty IN (1,2,3)),
      points REAL NOT NULL CHECK(points > 0),
      prompt TEXT NOT NULL,
      payload TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(payload)),
      explanation TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
      source TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]' CHECK(json_valid(source)),
      origin TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(origin IN ('manual','template','generated')),
      provenance TEXT CHECK(provenance IS NULL OR json_valid(provenance)),
      status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active' CHECK(status IN ('active','retired')),
      review TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unreviewed' CHECK(review IN ('approved','unreviewed','rejected')),
      reviewed_at TEXT, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
    )

objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE question_review (
      user_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      question_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES question_items(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,

      due_on TEXT NOT NULL,
      last_result TEXT,
      created_at TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
      PRIMARY KEY (user_id, question_id)
    )

      created_at TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL

      created_at TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
